_doc: phase-488 — per-example edit counts for porting the stock rclcpp examples to nros-cpp. See edit_count.py. `edited_lines_before_phase_488` is the measurement against the headers this fixture was added to; `remaining` names each cause still costing edits.

remaining: exceptions: the try/catch around publish + spin_some is removed (RFC-0018, -fno-exceptions; there is no rclcpp::exceptions::RCLError)
global Node::SharedPtr from a temporary: `g_node = rclcpp::Node::make_shared(...)` is refused because Node::SharedPtr does not own; keep the shared_ptr in a local (`auto node = ...; g_node = node;`)
global Node::SharedPtr from a temporary (as minimal_subscriber_not_composable)
actions: no ServerGoalHandle / rclcpp_action::create_server(node interfaces, std::bind...) — the server is created in place and callbacks are function pointers keyed by the 16-byte goal id
no hidden threads: the stock example detaches a std::thread per goal; the port runs the goal in the accepted callback and drops rclcpp::Rate::sleep (it would re-enter the executor from a callback)

actions: no ClientGoalHandle / create_client(node interfaces) / async_send_goal future; SendGoalOptions are raw function pointers with a context, feedback/result arrive as CDR bytes to deserialize, and the result is requested with get_result_async
generated sequences are FixedSequence/HeapSequence, not std::vector: `.back()` / `.size()` are spelled `[length() - 1]` / `.length()` (`size` is the layout's length field)
MultiThreadedExecutor is refused (RFC-0002: one task per executor, no hidden threads) — renamed to SingleThreadedExecutor

callback groups: create_callback_group(CallbackGroupType) / SubscriptionOptions::callback_group / CallbackGroup::SharedPtr have no counterpart (every group is mutually exclusive on one task); the group plumbing is deleted
